fields.description:
Developer metadata access policy.

all: any eligible existing DocType on this site.
allowlist: only the DocTypes listed below.

Any unset, invalid or unreadable value denies metadata access. There is no permissive default.
fields.label: Metadata Access Mode

fields.description: Maximum metadata fields returned for a permitted DocType. Supported range 1 to 500; the immutable service ceiling of 500 fields always applies at runtime.
fields.label: Max Schema Fields

fields.description: Maximum serialized metadata payload size in bytes. Supported range 4096 to 131072 bytes; the immutable service ceiling of 131072 bytes always applies at runtime. May be shown in KB on Desk; enforcement is byte-based.
fields.label: Max Schema Payload Size (bytes)

fields.description: Frappe Roles that confer the NexMate Developer capability. When one or more roles are listed here, this list takes precedence over the site-configuration developer roles. When this list is empty on a saved record, no Developer roles are granted. When NexMate Settings has never been saved, the site-configuration value applies.
fields.label: Developer Roles

fields.description: Maximum business-record rows returned for a read request. Supported range 1 to 100; the immutable service ceiling of 100 rows always applies at runtime. Narrows only: Frappe authorization and field allowlists are unaffected.
fields.label: Max Records per Query

fields.description: Maximum business-record fields returned for a read request. Supported range 1 to 50; the immutable service ceiling of 50 fields always applies at runtime.
fields.label: Max Fields per Query

fields.description: Maximum business-record read payload size in bytes. Supported range 4096 to 131072 bytes; the immutable service ceiling of 131072 bytes always applies at runtime. May be shown in KB on Desk; enforcement is byte-based.
fields.label: Max Read Payload Size (bytes)

fields.description: Maximum inference-to-Frappe read rounds for a single ask. Supported range 1 to 5; the immutable service ceiling of 5 rounds always applies at runtime.
fields.label: Max Read Rounds

fields.description: DocTypes a Developer-capability user may inspect when the mode is allowlist. Child tables and Single DocTypes are never accepted here and cannot be inspected regardless of mode.
fields.label: Permitted DocTypes
